observations: Photo 0 shows a cream-colored electric sewing machine with a black control panel.
The machine has two large gold-colored dials on the front panel.
There is a black foot pedal connected by a white cord.

The background is a tiled floor, suggesting an indoor setting.

No photo shows the machine in operation or any stitch examples. The claim cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on, needle moving, and stitching fabric.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged power cord or foot pedal
risks.proof: Photo showing the full power cord and foot pedal connected to the machine.

risks.risk: Machine may have electrical faults or wear affecting performance
risks.proof: Close-up of the motor, wiring, and internal components under inspection.

Photo of the full power cord and foot pedal.
Close-up of the motor and internal components.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
